rules.summary: Opening, binding or passing /dev/uinput or /dev/input/* to a container or process (device flags, compose devices, direct paths).
Bind-mounting host input, X11 socket, Xauthority or Wayland socket paths into a container or sandbox (including ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/${WAYLAND_DISPLAY} spellings).
Device-cgroup rules granting major 13 (input) with any minor, e.g. 'c 13:* rwm' or 'a 13:* rwm'.

Loading or permissioning the host uinput route: modprobe/insmod uinput, chmod/chgrp/chown/setfacl/mknod on /dev/uinput or /dev/input, sg/newgrp input, systemd DeviceAllow, modules-load.d uinput entries.

Projecting a host display: inheriting ${DISPLAY}/${WAYLAND_DISPLAY}/${XAUTHORITY}, exporting or setting a display without same-boundary private creation, bare /tmp/.X11-unix or .Xauthority paths, xdotool/xhost/xwd, source set_var("DISPLAY"|"WAYLAND_DISPLAY"|"XAUTHORITY").
Writing the host clipboard: wl-copy/xclip/xsel, arboard/copypasta/x11-clipboard/wl-clipboard-rs/gtk::Clipboard deps, copy_text()/copy_image() APIs.

Fail closed: a value that could not be resolved statically (container device/volume/env values, runs-on expressions, malformed shell/YAML/host-map, contract violations such as stale or duplicate inventory rows).

dormant-k-consumer.summary: Kernel-fidelity (K) consumer that is stopped on runner hosts in wave 1; removal is scheduled by the named wave-2 bead.

product-reference.summary: Product source that references host paths as data (policy constants, validation), never executed against the host in CI.

product-session-fixture.summary: Test fixture asserting on product session values (broker sockets, display env spellings) without touching the host.

guest_internal.summary: Occurrence only reachable inside a pfvd guest; the caller= entry point must exist, match guest_entry_points and reference the occurrence file.

product_clipboard_adapter.summary: Product clipboard adapter whose host route is gated off in CI; the occurrence file must carry the gate marker.

forms: Xvfb :N started in the boundary with literal DISPLAY=:N and owned cleanup (trap/kill)
weston --backend=headless* with a generated socket under a run-private XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
private_compositor.summary: Creation and consumption must appear in the same test boundary (one shell file, one workflow run block). There is no free-form allowlist.

requires: source-kind file that literally carries the broker X11 source path
product_session_capability.summary: Excuses the bare /tmp/.X11-unix destination spelling only inside product source files that carry the broker-owned capability source; never workflows, shell scripts or systemd units.

requires: gate marker present in the occurrence file

runner_label_map.matching: GitHub subset: a job's label set matches an entry when it is a subset of the entry's complete labels, or every label fnmatches one of the entry's label_patterns. Reusable-workflow calls (uses: without runs-on) are evaluated in the callee file.
runner_label_map.consumer_policy: A job carrying any host-input/display/clipboard finding that matches at least one committed host fails with host_consumer_job; a consumer matching none fails with no_eligible_host; dynamic runs-on fails with dynamic_runs_on.

failure_contract.output: host_route_inventory=FAIL reason=<rule> path=<path> line=<line> rule=<rule> detail=<detail> text=<stripped line>
